about: How each table of the glossary on site/index.html is laid out. The rows come from
builder/inputs/components.csv: a glyph gets a row in every section its `glossary` column names
(the Builder's Glyphs > List view, column Glossary), by its title ("1c: Left Hand Techniques"), two separated
by "; ". Each title starts with its id; the id is the key and the check keeps the titles the same in both files.
rewrites the tables between the <!-- glossary <id> --> markers; headings and text around them stay as written.
A section gets a Meaning column (components.csv `meaning`) once any of its glyphs has a meaning.
kind 'hidden' (99: Hidden in Glossary): no table and no marker on the page; its glyphs are left out on
purpose, so the check doesn't report them as missing.
kind 'usage': ASCII | 中文 | 拼音 | an example word. `usage` is the example as [ASCII, 中文]; {} is the glyph's
spelling, marked red; <r>…</r> marks more. `examples` overrides it for one glyph.
kind 'vertical': each spelling after a colon, typed on its own. Consecutive numbers (md_1 to md_13) share one row.
Words written together (:带起) are rows of builder/inputs/words.csv (the Builder's Glyphs > Words view).
A section's rows go by the `glossary_order` column (components.csv and words.csv: a number, decimals allowed,
one per section, 3; 12, when a glyph has two), ties alphabetically by the ASCII spelling, rows without one last.
